key_moments: Habib Diarra opened the scoring for Senegal in the 25th minute, capitalizing on a rebound after Ismaïla Sarr's header hit the post.
Ismaïla Sarr doubled Senegal's lead in the 51st minute with a brilliant chest control and finish from a long pass.
Romelu Lukaku pulled one back for Belgium in the 86th minute, sparking a late comeback.
Youri Tielemans equalized for Belgium in the 89th minute, forcing the match into extra time.
Youri Tielemans converted a penalty in the 125th minute after a VAR review, securing Belgium's dramatic victory.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the equalizer and the winning penalty in extra time.
Came off the bench to score a crucial goal, initiating Belgium's comeback.
Scored a spectacular goal and was a constant threat on the wing.
Made several key saves to keep Belgium in the game when Senegal was leading.

matches.tactical_summary: Senegal initially executed a strong game plan, utilizing pace on the wings and effective counter-attacks to build a two-goal lead. Belgium, after tactical substitutions, shifted to a more aggressive pressing style, overwhelming Senegal in the final minutes of regulation and extra time.

narrative: Belgium staged an extraordinary comeback in the Round of 32, overturning a two-goal deficit against Senegal with two late goals in regulation time. The drama culminated in extra time when Youri Tielemans converted a penalty in the 125th minute, securing a thrilling 3-2 victory and breaking Senegalese hearts.
next_round_notes: Belgium will face the winner of the match between the United States and Bosnia & Herzegovina in the Round of 16. Senegal's Lamine Camara received a yellow card during the match.
